Video Game Music Maker Free — Version 1.0.0

- Initial release with automatic cloud-based AI background music generation for video game clips.
- Supports uploads of MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM files up to 500MB.
- Provides easy export of music-scored videos, with processing times of 30-90 seconds per clip.
- Free tier includes 100 credits valid for 7 days, with simple anonymous authentication.
- API-based workflows for uploading, music generation, export, credits check, and session management.
- Designed for indie developers to create royalty-free, looping chiptune BGM for game videos.
